summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.86/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.86 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 5, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 5¢ higher than a week ago, 36¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.00 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.64) and the highest in Superior ($4.06).
